service.method: SELECT USER_ID ,USER_NAME_LOC ,PROCESS_ID ,METHOD_NAME ,PROGRAM_DESC ,JOB_TYPE ,JOB_DATE ,JOB_TIME ,IP FROM SULOG WHERE 1=1 AND JOB_DATE >= $S{F_PR_DATE_FROM} AND JOB_DATE <= $S{F_PR_DATE_TO} AND JOB_TYPE IN ($INS{F_TYPE}) AND UPPER(PROCESS_ID) LIKE '%' || UPPER($S{F_PROCESS_ID}) || '%' AND UPPER(METHOD_NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER($S{F_METHOD_NAME}) || '%' AND ( 1=1 AND UPPER(USER_ID) LIKE '%' || UPPER($S{F_USER}) || '%' OR UPPER(USER_NAME_LOC) LIKE '%' || UPPER($S{F_USER}) || '%' ) AND (1=1 AND UPPER(USER_ID) LIKE '%' || UPPER($S{KEYWORD}) || '%' OR UPPER(USER_NAME_LOC) LIKE '%' || UPPER($S{KEYWORD}) || '%' OR UPPER(PROCESS_ID) LIKE '%' || UPPER($S{KEYWORD}) || '%' OR UPPER(METHOD_NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER($S{KEYWORD}) || '%' OR UPPER(PROGRAM_DESC) LIKE '%' || UPPER($S{KEYWORD}) || '%' ) ORDER BY JOB_DATE desc, JOB_TIME desc
